bottom_line: In black patients with NYHA class III or IV heart failure, isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine vs placebo improved the primary composite score (−0.1±1.9 vs. −0.5±2.0, P=0.01).
implications: In this trial of 1050 patients, adding isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine (vs placebo) was associated with better mean primary composite score (−0.1±1.9 vs. −0.5±2.0, P=0.01) and lower all-cause mortality (32 [6.2%] vs 54 [10.2%]; hazard ratio, 0.57; P=0.01). The trial was stopped early, and the mean follow-up was 10 months (range, 0 to 18), so the reported estimates reflect outcomes over that follow-up period.

major_points.text: Randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial in the United States enrolling self-identified black patients with advanced heart failure.
major_points.quote: The African-American Heart Failure Trial (A-HeFT) was a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial with patients recruited at 161 centers in the United States.

major_points.text: Population: 1050 black patients with NYHA class III or IV heart failure with dilated ventricles.
major_points.quote: A total of 1050 black patients who had New York Heart Association class III or IV heart failure with dilated ventricles were randomly assigned

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was a weighted composite of all-cause death, first heart-failure hospitalization, and quality-of-life change.
major_points.quote: The primary end point was a composite score made up of weighted values for death from any cause, a first hospitalization for heart failure, and change in the quality of life.

major_points.text: Trial was terminated early due to significantly higher mortality in the placebo group.
major_points.quote: The study was terminated early owing to a significantly higher mortality rate in the placebo group than in the group given isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine (10.2 percent vs. 6.2 percent, P=0.02).

major_points.text: All-cause mortality was lower with isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine (hazard ratio 0.57; P=0.01).
major_points.quote: 43 percent reduction in the rate of death from any cause [hazard ratio, 0.57; P=0.01]

major_points.text: First hospitalization for heart failure was reduced with combination therapy.
major_points.quote: First hospitalization for heart failure [16.4 percent vs. 22.4 percent, P=0.001]

major_points.text: Adverse events: headache and dizziness were more frequent with combination therapy; CHF exacerbations were more frequent with placebo.
major_points.quote: Symptoms of headache and dizziness were significantly more frequent in the group given isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine, whereas exacerbations of congestive heart failure (both moderate and severe) were significantly more frequent in the placebo group.
